svg.text: Read the names printed beside the screen's pins. 'SDO(MISO)' and 'T_IRQ' stay empty; 'GND' is on the ground-chain page.
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
screen: the pin printed 'VCC' (pin 1) -> Seed3 socket
screen: the pin printed 'CS' (pin 3) -> Seed3 socket
screen: the pin printed 'DC' (pin 5) -> Seed3 socket
screen: the pin printed 'SCK' (pin 7) -> Seed3 socket
screen: the pin printed 'LED' (pin 8) -> Seed3 socket
